tiers.tier: Tier 1: Pure TP=8 Only on 256K Context (Single-Node · OOM or 19.8s Unsharded Sequence Bottleneck)
Tier 2: Pure Ring Attention CP=16 across 2 Nodes (P2P KV Ring · Small Chunk Overlap Collapse)
Tier 3: Pure DeepSpeed Ulysses SP=16 across 2 Nodes (Blocked by GQA-8 Head Limit & Cross-Node All-to-All)
Tier 4: 2D Hybrid USP (Intra-Node NVLink Ulysses=8 × Inter-Node RDMA Ring=2) + FlashAttention-3 FP8
